extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of 19th-century American politics, history, and Horace Greeley's memoirs (also young men seeking practical advice)
extracted.subtask_description: A full-text digitized edition of Horace Greeley's memoirs and miscellanies, containing autobiographical recollections, political commentary, essays, and a published discussion on marriage and divorce. Intended as a readable primary-source book-length memoir.
